t: This is Westminster Bridge, a road and foot bridge over the River Thames, linking Westminster on the west side with Lambeth on the east. It was designed by Thomas Page, who lived from 1803 to 1877. Page was an English architect and civil engineer, responsible for the design and construction of many bridges. Besides this one, he also built the first Chelsea Bridge. So the span under your feet comes from a man whose career was spent putting bridges across the Thames.
